bifrost: none for app-facing accessory sessions; OS layer: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (device list, pairing, audio route flag), springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (bluetooth_spec, line 378), springboard/src/bare/input.rs (evdev input devices, shell only), springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs (camera devices, shell only)
summary: Apple's framework connects apps to MFi hardware over Lightning, 30-pin or Bluetooth, with a per-protocol byte stream and connect/disconnect notifications; the doc notes iOS-family apps on Apple silicon Macs cannot use it. BifrOSt has an app view of an accessory (built from the USB accessory manager model), but no accessory discovery, sessions, protocol matching or Wi-Fi accessory setup reach apps. The shell manages Bluetooth pairing and devices, but apps get no API for them.

features.note: Apps register for connect and disconnect notifications and take them in order, and a registration that is cancelled drops the queue; tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: no bus source drives attach and detach on a real device, which needs hardware and a Midget check.

features.apple: EAAccessory (name, manufacturer, modelNumber, serialNumber, protocolStrings, isConnected, connectionID) https://developer.apple.com/documentation/externalaccessory/eaaccessory
features.note: Accessory::from_core builds the app view (identity, protocol strings, connection id, connected state) from the USB accessory manager record, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: wired accessories are not modelled, and no bus event feeds the view yet, which needs hardware.

Protocol strings match exactly, a session is refused for a disconnected accessory or an undeclared protocol, and the matches are listed in attach order; tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: no manifest key declares accessory protocols and the sandbox grants no accessory device, so an app cannot reach hardware yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/external_accessory.rs (Session, input_stream, output_stream, receive, take_output), springboard/sdk/src/stream.rs; tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs
features.note: A session carries bytes in both directions through its input and output streams, and closing refuses writes; tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: the transport that moves bytes to and from a real accessory needs hardware.

features.apple: EAAccessoryManager showBluetoothAccessoryPicker (Bluetooth MFi accessory selection sheet)
features.note: An app's request (a name filter and device kinds) builds the picker, and the app receives only the chosen address; tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-35.rs. Gap: the request does not cross the shell boundary yet, so no app can open the picker for itself, and the pairing sheet remains a shell feature.

features.apple: EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessoryBrowser, EAWiFiUnconfiguredAccessory, Wireless Accessory Configuration Entitlement https://developer.apple.com/documentation/externalaccessory/eawifiunconfiguredaccessorybrowser
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (theme-19, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No scan for unconfigured Wi-Fi accessories and no configuration hand-off. The Wi-Fi stack (netd) is OS-level and has no app API for this.

features.apple: Not in the framework; closest analogue for hardware input is GameController and CoreMIDI (outside this matrix)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/external_accessory.rs (accessory registry, connect and disconnect, data sessions); springboard/sdk/src/hid_devices.rs (HID device matching and changes); springboard/ui/src/device_match.rs (capability filter); springboard/src/bare/input.rs (evdev discovery, shell only); springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs (V4L2 camera devices, shell only)
features.note: Apps see connected accessories and HID devices by role and transport, and open data sessions over the protocols an accessory declares, all in tested pure models. Gap: the shell opens the devices and no transport moves bytes to them, and apps never receive raw input events.

features.apple: Not part of this framework (MFi uses Lightning and 30-pin, which BifrOSt does not expose); USB is covered by AccessoryAccess and serial is not an Apple accessory API
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (serial_ports.rs, serial_ports.rs, external_accessory.rs, usb_descriptors.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. Checked for serial and USB device access in springboard/ with a text search: only the PTY (springboard/src/term/pty.rs), the installer and the DRM driver (springboard/wm/src/drm.rs) matched. Recorded for completeness; the USB side belongs to the AccessoryAccess matrix row.

gaps: No SDK accessory manager or connect/disconnect events for apps (EAAccessoryManager).
The app view of an accessory (Accessory::from_core) has no bus source yet, and the sandbox binds no accessory device nodes.
No EASession byte stream for a declared accessory protocol, and no manifest key or sandbox grant for accessory protocols (app_policy.rs binds only /dev/snd and /dev/dri).
No Bluetooth accessory picker callable from an app; the picker exists only in Settings (shell/pages.rs bluetooth_spec).
No Wi-Fi unconfigured accessory browser or configuration flow.
Bluetooth device state (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs Device) is not surfaced through any SDK type.
